title: a typed local does not discharge a successor future
purpose: Annotating a local as Future<T> is not a handoff: a never-awaited successor future is still a must-use error (#790).

failure.justification: Statically visible loss is a semantic error; runtime discard checks remain defensive.

provenance.origin: authored for #790 from the owner's decision of 2026-11-21
provenance.expected_basis: spec 11.1: a typed local declaration is not a handoff boundary; the local keeps Future<^T> and its obligation.
